title.narrative: Strengthening the quality system of technology and industrial products and services in Bosnia and Herzegovina: Coordinate Measuring Machine Competence Centre

description.narrative: Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH) is currently not able to assure comparability to international standards and approved quality control m ethod. Therefore, the CMM competence centre under public-private-academia partnership will benefit the entire country in terms of providing new opportunities for the economy and enabling access to EU and international markets by providing acclaimed recognition by accredited bodies. Besides new education possibilities and services to industries, the CMM competence centre, located at the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Computing will also enable advanced research in the field of product quality control in cooperation with local and broader industrial companies. As a consequence of such cooperation, the companies will strengthen their development and innovation capabilities and thus become much more competitive in EU market. In addition, the competence centre will also comprise a length calibration laboratory and that will support the conformity assessment infrastructure in the region as well as in entire BiH
